summary: Nex Core has one version, the nex-core-local package version: its postinst owns /etc/os-release and refreshes the console banners on install and update, the installer and ISO derive their labels and file name from the package, and the Controller host page shows a single Version row instead of Operating system plus Agent version. API impact: none (inventory fields os_version/agent_version unchanged; descriptions clarified). Also fixes BUG-0041 in the capture harness.

guide.reason: Operators see one Nex Core version on the host page and in /etc/os-release; ISO file names and identity checks changed.

api.reason: No contract change; the os_version and agent_version field descriptions now state that both carry the single Nex Core version.

state.reason: /etc/os-release and console banners are owned by the nex-core-local package; the Controller shows the reported version and stores nothing.

verification.method: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' (84 tests, includes the new postinst check using real dpkg-divert/dpkg-query against a temporary root); real dpkg 1.23.7 chrootless install of 0.1.5~alpha1 then upgrade to 0.1.6~alpha1 into a temporary root; ./installer/check.sh; python3 scripts/generate_api.py --check; npm run typecheck and build in web/; Playwright Controller capture harness against a real Controller with simulated inventory; python3 scripts/check_docs.py --all. Simulation: no ISO rebuild, live host, or apt update was run.
